Strong in microservices, event-drivenarchitecture, serverless, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on with AI/ML integration fordecisioning, dynamic pricing and recommendations; comfortable leveraging AI developer tools(Cursor, Copilot) to improve quality and velocity. Proven business impact: higher sign-ups,conversions, and revenue uplift on consumer platforms.Programming: JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Python, SQL, GraphQL, WebSocketsFrameworks: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, LoopBack, Flask, ReactCloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, CloudFront, ECR,CloudWatch, Athena), Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, GitHub ActionsData Stores: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, ElasticsearchMessaging & Data: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AirflowObservability & Marketing: Datadog, Kibana, GA4, Segment, BrazeAI/ML: Model integration (risk scoring, recommendations), TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain,OpenAI API, LLM orchestrationPractices: Microservices, Serverless, Event-Driven, CI/CD, Testing, Security Hardening (2FA,account lockout)SUMMARYPROJECT SUMMARYAI-Powered Real-Time Interview Scheduling Agent — Senior SoftwareDeveloperTECHNICAL SKILLS SUMMARY

Organization: EPAM (Client: Atlassian) — RemoteEnvironment: LlamaIndex, Anthropic Claude API, Node.js, Redis, WebSockets, Google CalendarAPI, Microsoft Outlook Calendar APIDescription: Developed a real-time scheduling agent integrating LlamaIndex with Google andOutlook calendar APIs. Integrated an intelligent conversational agent that automatically resolvestime-zone conflicts, reschedules dropouts, and delivers automated pre-interview reminders.Roles & Responsibilities:• Built real-time multi-calendar scheduling workflows with automated conflict resolution andrescheduling.• Automated 90% of manual recruiter coordination tasks, reducing interviewdropouts/no-shows by 30%.• Implemented conversational scheduling using LlamaIndex and Anthropic Claude API, withRedis and WebSockets for low-latency state and real-time updates.Organization: Emirates National Bank Dubai (D4Insight) — Remote | Mar 2025 – PresentEnvironment: Node.js (TypeScript, Nest/Express), Microservices, AWS, PostgreSQL/DynamoDB,Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, DatadogDescription: Built a fault-tolerant decisioning platform orchestrating multiple AI/ML models forcredit-risk based on repayment patterns and behavioral data; enabled real-time approvals withexplainability and continuous-feedback loops.Roles & Responsibilities:• Designed microservices with saga/outbox patterns for reliable workflows.• Implemented model orchestration (inference routing, retraining hooks, feedback capture).• Automated compliance checks with LLM-driven document parsing.• Established observability (tracing, logs, metrics) and CI/CD for safe rollouts.Loan Decision Management System (Personal & Corporate Lending) — SeniorSoftware Developer

Enterprise Platforms (Survey Cert & Loan Processing) — Senior SoftwareEngineerOrganization: Infosys — Bengaluru | Aug 2018 – Jun 2021Environment: Node.js/Express, Redis, SQL, React (frontends), CI/CDDescription: Rebuilt Caterpillar Survey Certification backend for reliability/perf; developed loanprocessing platform improving TAT and throughput; enhanced CI/CD for React & Node fordeployment stability and QA.Roles & Responsibilities:English (Fluent), Hindi (Native)B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering — JSS Academy of Technical Education, India(2014–2018)• Designed APIs, caching layers, and DB optimizations.• Strengthened CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.• Business Impact: +35% user acquisition, +19% conversions, +34% revenue uplift via dynamicpricing.• Architecture Modernization: Legacy → microservices/serverless, 99.9% uptime maintained.• AI in Production: Credit-risk scoring, dynamic pricing, recommendations; AI-assisted codingadoption.EDUCATIONLANGUAGESKEY ACHIEVEMENTS
